name: eBay Agent Tool Server
description: A read-only server for retrieving, searching, and comparing eBay Browse API listings.

requiredConfiguration.name: API_KEYS
requiredConfiguration.description: Inbound API keys when API-key authentication is selected.

requiredConfiguration.name: AUTH_MODE
requiredConfiguration.description: Selects API-key or local disabled authentication.

requiredConfiguration.name: EBAY_ENVIRONMENT
requiredConfiguration.description: Selects the eBay production or sandbox environment.

tools.name: ebay_get_listing
tools.summary: Retrieve structured listing data from an eBay URL or item ID.

tools.name: ebay_search_listings
tools.summary: Search active eBay listings with bounded filters.

tools.name: ebay_find_similar_listings
tools.summary: Find active comparable listings using documented identifiers and keywords.

tools.name: ebay_compare_listings
tools.summary: Compare active listings without making a recommendation.

notes: The source repository does not yet contain the required server.json.
